topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: My lord, how is it that such a thing could happen? The carriage, nay, the iron horse was right there in the place where it belongs, under the shadow of my humble abode. I did nothing, spoke to no one. The only talk was of the coming harvest, the prayers to Saint Isidore for rain, and the worries over the debt that hangs heavy as the clouds. And yet, they came in the night, or so some say, and took it away. What am I to do? The soil is hungry, the seeds need planting, and without it, I am but a man with hands on a plot that needs more than what I can give. I pray you, good people, if you know the way to bring it back, show me. The harvest waits for no one, and I fear if this iron beast does not return, all we have known will turn to thistles and dust.
